summary: Oryntix iteration-10 regression (post security/code-review fixes) verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass against the public preview URL — (a) POST /conversations/{cid}/send on a 2-persona meeting emits exactly 2 persona finals and NO is_moderator event on turn 1; turn 2 does not create a meeting_notes task (moderator stuck-check gated); (b) POST /conversations/{cid}/summary returns 200 with summary and creates exactly one meeting_notes task; 400 on private; (c) /summary succeeds when called by budi@aivora.ai after being invited via POST /participants (participant access allowed, not just creator); (d) POST /invite-link returns token (len>=32 — token_urlsafe(24)==32 chars), path /join/<token>, expires_at ~7 days ahead (6<delta<8 days); GET /invites/<token> 200, GET /invites/bogus 404 with 'Undangan tidak valid atau sudah kedaluwarsa'; POST /invites/<token>/register with new email returns access_token and the user appears in GET /admin/workspace-users with daily_credit_limit=200; (e) GET /conversations and /conversations/{cid}/messages .conversation no longer contain 'invite_token' (confirmed via projection {_id:0, invite_token:0}); (f) POST /conversations with a non-existent persona_id → 400 'Pilih minimal satu persona...'; (g) GET /api/files/aivora/videos/<uid>/../other/x.mp4?auth=<tok> → 403, GET /api/files/other/videos/<uid>/x.mp4?auth=<tok> → 403; (h) POST /voice/tts {text:'halo',voice:'nova'} → 200 audio/mpeg (sanity). Frontend: Landing page shows oryntix-logo + 'Intelligence, Orchestrated.' tagline; login with demo@aivora.ai/demo123456 → /home. On /chat opened an existing group/meeting conv (data-testid conv-<id>) — header shows BOTH save-notes-btn and video-call-btn. Sent 'Mari diskusikan rencana peluncuran produk minggu depan.' → wait_for 2 new msg-assistant bubbles → got exactly 2 added persona replies with NO moderator label on the two newly-added messages. Clicked save-notes-btn → toast 'Notulen tersimpan di Ruang Kerja' appeared; /workspace now contains 'Notulen rapat' entry. Private chat (new-chat-btn → 1 persona) correctly hides save-notes-btn and video-call-btn and shows call-mode-btn ('Panggil').

issues: Pre-existing: a legacy persona with empty name still yields auto-titles like 'Meeting: , Rio', 'Chat dengan ', 'Grup: , Rio'. Carried over from iter9, cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: chat.py send_message moderator block (L378-385): correctly gated behind ctype=='meeting' AND user_turns>=2 AND await _is_stuck(cid) — confirmed turn 1 never emits a moderator event. The legacy MsgIn.moderator flag is now a no-op comment only, matching spec (a). Good.

chat.py create_invite_link uses secrets.token_urlsafe(24) which yields 32-char URL-safe tokens — meets 'len>=32' requirement. Reuses existing token until it expires; refreshes only when expired. Clean.
chat.py _conv_by_invite returns 404 with detail 'Undangan tidak valid atau sudah kedaluwarsa' for both missing and expired tokens — single error path prevents enumeration oracle. ✓
chat.py invite_register: INVITE_DEFAULT_DAILY_LIMIT=200 set on new user; also sets joined_via_invite:true and inherits owner's language/timezone/theme. verified via /admin/workspace-users. ✓
chat.py list_conv and get_messages both project {_id:0, invite_token:0} — invite_token no longer leaked to clients. ✓
chat.py create_conv calls _get_personas(x.persona_ids, workspace_id(u)) scoped by workspace, then raises 400 if none resolved — proper tenant isolation on foreign persona_ids. ✓
chat.py meeting_summary uses _can_access(conv, u) which allows creator, listed participants, OR workspace admin — correctly broadens from creator-only (spec c). Still rejects private with 400. ✓

files.py serve_file: checks `any(seg in ('', '.', '..'))` and `'\\' in path`, then requires parts[0]=='aivora' and parts[2]==uid — both path traversal and wrong-prefix return 403 as required (spec g). Note: FastAPI/urllib may canonicalize '/..' at the ingress before reaching the handler; however with %2E%2E or embedded in the middle it still hits serve_file, and in our test the server returned 403 as expected.

Chat.jsx saveNotes posts /summary and surfaces toast 'Notulen tersimpan di Ruang Kerja'; data-testid save-notes-btn conditionally rendered only when conv.type !== 'private' — matches spec (b). The resulting Moderator message injected into the chat appears styled with a '· moderator' label; our heuristic text-contains('moderator') on the message body returned 0 because the badge is rendered outside .msg-assistant content wrapper. Not a bug; the toast + Workspace 'Notulen rapat' entry confirm the flow.

Markdown.jsx safeHref — not re-tested in this iteration (no live javascript: links to render), but code change is covered by code review only. Suggest adding a unit test if a jsdom runner is available.
test_credentials: Admin demo@aivora.ai / demo123456; Regular budi@aivora.ai / budi123456
seed_data_creation: Each test creates/deletes its own conversations (TEST_iter10_meet, TEST_iter10_priv, TEST_iter10_part). test_invite_register_sets_daily_limit_200 creates and deletes a transient user (test_invite_<rand>@aivora.ai). test_summary_creates_one_meeting_notes_task leaves one meeting_notes task behind — expected side effect of the feature under test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_oryntix_iter10.py covers all iteration-10 regression items. Note (minor): workspace-users filters by owner_id==workspace_id(admin) and the backend lowercases emails on registration — assertions must use lowercase. The invite_token token length is exactly 32 (secrets.token_urlsafe(24)). LLM calls can take 5-30s; wait_for_function timeout of 120s was sufficient. The pre-existing orphan persona with empty name is still present in the demo workspace.
rca of the issue: No bugs. All review-request items pass. One test fixture glitch encountered during authoring (email case mismatch) was fixed in-test; code under review is correct.
